about: Line primitives survey (roadmap item 1): descriptors only, read from each library's public type definitions (shadcn/ui: its public registry JSON). No library code is copied. Regenerate with packages/line-primitives/scripts/survey.mjs.

method.components: Every exported value whose type is callable and returns a React element. A namespace export (Radix, Ark, Chakra) is one component whose members are its parts; a flat export that extends another export by a part word (DialogTitle, TableRow) is a part of it, unless its own name is a cluster (IconButton).
method.props: The component's own props across all its parts: DOM attributes, aria-*, data-*, CSS and style-system props are dropped by declaration file.
method.states: Prop names mapped to canonical states by vocabulary.mjs (disabled, isDisabled -> disabled; error, isInvalid -> invalid; ...).
method.events: on* props mapped to canonical events by vocabulary.mjs; DOM pass-through, pointer, hover and animation callbacks are kept apart as passThroughEvents.
method.clusters: Each top-level component falls into the first clusters.mjs pattern its name matches. Cluster states, events, parts and frequency use the training sources only; held-out sources (chakra, mantine) are used by the coverage metric.
